title: AgentTaskObject
description: The single JSON contract passed between PM -> Architect -> Coding -> Testing -> Review -> Manager/Reflection. Every agent's system prompt must say: 'Output only valid JSON matching this schema. No prose, no explanation outside the JSON.' Never paraphrase this object between agents.

task_id.description: Unique id for this task, e.g. 'task_001'.

feature_request.description: The original plain-English request typed by the human.

acceptance_criteria.description: Concrete, testable criteria written by the PM Agent. Testing Agent checks results against these directly.

scoped_files.description: File paths (relative to sample repo root) the Architect Agent decided are relevant. Only these get loaded into Coding/Testing/Review context -- never the whole repo.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the task.

current_agent.description: Which agent (or human) currently owns this task.

plan.description: Architect Agent's implementation plan / approach in plain terms. Null until Architect runs.

history.description: Ordered log of every agent that has touched this task, in the exact order they ran.

output_summary.description: One-line summary of what this agent did, e.g. 'criteria defined' or 'plan + files scoped'.

success.description: Did this agent's step succeed? Null if not yet evaluated. Manager Agent reads this field to compute per-agent success rates.

code_diff.description: Unified diff produced by the Coding Agent. Null until Coding Agent runs.

test_results.description: Structured output from the Testing Agent. Null until Testing Agent runs.

criteria_matched.description: Which acceptance_criteria entries this test run satisfied.

review_result.description: Structured findings from the Review Agent, per Section 10's security checklist. Null until Review Agent runs.

retry_count.description: Number of Review -> Coding retries so far. Hard capped at 2 -- on the 3rd rejection, escalate to a human instead of looping.

example.feature_request: Add rate limiting to the login endpoint
acceptance_criteria: Max 5 login attempts per IP per 10 minutes
All existing login tests still pass
example.plan: Add a token-bucket rate limiter middleware keyed by IP, wrap the login route with it, return 429 on exceed.
